advisories.note: basedOn.sdkJoinV6.role carries the one surviving deictic self-reference: 'This GATE leftover-join does not steal those leftovers.' It is not one of the three banned forms, it was present in frozen g20 leftover-join.v6 under dual ACCEPT 0/0, and it does disambiguating work in place — the sentence contrasts the GATE leftover-join (the DR-G20 speaker) with the ROW leftover-join (sdk, DR-125) named in the same string, so the referent is recoverable without external inference. Recorded as advisory rather than a finding. A successor may write 'g20 leftover-join.v7' there and reduce the deictic count to zero.

Four unqualified g20-lineage tokens remain, all verbatim-inherited from frozen g20 leftover-join.v6: 'leftover-join.v3 cited occupancy v1 as the specification' (occupancyV2.role), 'Recorded as leftover-join.v3 … leftover-join.v4 remasured occupancy v1 stale' (predecessorV3.role), 'Recorded leftover-join.v3 as current G20 leftover-join' (d195.role), and 'Recorded leftover-join.v4 as current G20 leftover-join' (d264.role). These are NOT a finding: the g20 leftover-join.v5 review recorded the governing convention explicitly — unqualified 'leftover-join.vN' denotes the g20 lineage and the sdk lineage is always qualified — and cited two of these four strings by name as correct exemplars of it. Both independent reviewers then returned ACCEPT 0/0 over bytes containing all four. The ambiguity hazard is nonetheless live in principle (sdk-leftover-join.v3 and .v4 exist, and 27 leftover-join lineages share the token shape), and g20 leftover-join.v7 already stems the speaker everywhere else — in occupancyV2.role it edited the trailing sentence from 'This join' to 'g20 leftover-join.v7' while leaving the adjacent bare token. A successor may finish the stemming so the document is self-carrying without relying on the convention.

Two advisories from the g20 leftover-join.v5 review persist unchanged and are re-recorded rather than re-discovered later. First, basedOn retains the key name 'g20v1' for occupancy v1 while the current occupancy sits under 'occupancyV2'; the role strings disambiguate correctly but the asymmetry remains. Second, predecessorV4.role still opens 'Recorded as current G20 leftover-join.' without the draft-time qualifier that registerRowNote and remeasurementClause both carry; it is past-tense recording language and doesNot denies present currency explicitly, so it stays advisory.

Every dispatch attack was run against live bytes and none is sustained. The candidate correctly retires leftover-design of the ten D-298 implementations as an authoring claim while keeping OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING open, rescoped to per-D-002-platform copies that g20-fixture-corpus.v5 explicitly does not author. The D-002 platform tuple is an exact in-order quotation of occupancy v2 rather than an invention. Last-heading custody resolves to the single claimant D-322. OBL-SDK-API-RESERVED stays on DR-125 and is not stolen. All 79 cited digests match live bytes and all 8 cited commits resolve to the recordings claimed. 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX, 3 advisories.
